test_cases.summary: This claim is for patient Jane M. Rodriguez (DOB: 1985-03-22, ID: PT-90210-JR) who was seen at Westside Medical Center on November 15, 2024 by Dr. Michael Chen (NPI: 1234567890). Three procedures were performed: an office visit of moderate complexity (CPT 99214, $185.00), an MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148, $1,250.00), and therapeutic exercises for 30 minutes (CPT 97110, $95.00). The MRI revealed a small central disc protrusion at L5-S1 and mild disc bulge at L4-L5 with mild bilateral facet arthropathy. Total charges are $1,530.00 with insurance covering $1,122.00 and patient responsibility of $408.00.

--- Document: pathology_report_002.pdf ---
Patient: Robert A. Thompson
DOB: 08/10/1972
Specimen: Gallbladder
Date Collected: 10/28/2024
Pathologist: Dr. Lisa Wong, MD

Gross Description:
Gallbladder measuring 9.5 x 3.2 cm. Serosal surface is smooth. Multiple yellow-green calculi ranging from 0.3 to 1.2 cm identified within the lumen.

Microscopic Description:
Chronic cholecystitis with cholelithiasis. Mild mucosal inflammation. No evidence of dysplasia or malignancy.

Diagnosis:
1. Chronic cholecystitis with cholelithiasis
2. No evidence of malignancy
test_cases.summary: Patient Robert A. Thompson (DOB: 1972-08-10, ID: PT-33445-RT) was admitted to Riverside Community Hospital from October 28-30, 2024 under the care of Dr. Sarah Patel (NPI: 9876543210). The primary diagnosis is gallbladder calculus without cholecystitis (K80.20), with secondary diagnoses of other gallbladder disease (K82.8) and type 2 diabetes (E11.9). The patient underwent a laparoscopic cholecystectomy (CPT 47562, $8,500.00) along with abdominal ultrasound (CPT 76700, $450.00). Hospital care included initial high-complexity evaluation (CPT 99223), subsequent moderate-complexity care (CPT 99232), and discharge management (CPT 99238). Pathology confirmed chronic cholecystitis with cholelithiasis and no malignancy. Total charges are $9,675.00 with insurance payment of $7,450.00 and patient responsibility of $2,225.00.

anomalies.description: Primary diagnosis code K80.20 indicates gallbladder calculus WITHOUT cholecystitis, but pathology report confirms chronic cholecystitis with cholelithiasis. The diagnosis code may need to be updated to K80.10 (calculus of gallbladder WITH cholecystitis).
Patient has type 2 diabetes (E11.9) listed as secondary diagnosis. Pre-operative clearance documentation for diabetic patient undergoing surgery is not present in the submitted documents.
